about: Reference promos for 12 of the 50 episodes. Drafted by reading the scripts (with Claude, a different model family from the Gemini models the tool uses), then reviewed by hand. Each entry is one promo an editor would cut: start/end line IDs and the core line the clip must contain. Not exhaustive: the tool can find good promos that are not listed here, so 'precision' against this set is a lower bound.
hit_rule: a tool promo matches a reference promo if time-IoU >= 0.35, or if it contains the core line and IoU >= 0.20

promos.note: 'You should turn around' -> sister: 'Because he is marrying me.' Altar betrayal reveal.
Father won't look at her -> 'You are the daughter people tolerate... I am the daughter they choose.'
'Guards! Remove her!' -> stranger: 'Take your hands off her', drops a guard, groom: 'He's only one man!'
Stranger defends her, kneels with a ring: 'Lady Juliana... accept my hand.' Ends before her answer.
Stepmother flings her dead mother's ledger into the mud; sister and ex laugh.
Father disowns her on the church steps: 'you are dead to the Ashcroft family' -> 'You are my father!'
Ex mocks her 'scarred beggar' husband and threatens him -> husband walks up silently, ex freezes.
'Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!' -> constable search -> 'Search it.'
Search of the cottage; watch pulled from the husband's coat: 'There it is.'
'I want to see you crawl, sister' - bare-handed in the thorns or he hangs -> 'Tell me where the garden is.'
She crawls into frozen blackthorn briars while they mock her and he screams.
Burning cottage: she runs back into the fire for her mother's ledger, ceiling falls, he dives on her.
'Then let her suffer.' Noblewoman strikes the 'maid' with a riding crop, sends her to scrub the hearth.
Duchess recognises the ring: 'My lost son wore that ring!' 'What is your husband's name?' -> doors burst open.
'Poison.' Villains twist it: 'She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison!' -> 'Take her.'
Chained heroine paraded at the villains' wedding -> cathedral doors explode, armed figures in the smoke.
Duke denounces the villain, proclaims Juliana his wife and Duchess -> 'Juliana?!'
Proclaimed Duchess -> bishop bursts in: no Crown licence, 'You are not his lawful wife.'
